report:
Baseline: independently verified exact byte equality of both historical implementation sources and all three historical test-source files against the current workspace. Reassessed the complete current claim, both implementation entries and all five test entries; prior approval is context, not execution evidence.
Source assessment: ContractSession preserves unknown operations, unexpected roots and malformed exits as violations, missing receiver identity and incomplete scope as gaps, and finish permits calls_conform only when both collections are empty. Violations retain the observed invocation path and applicable ContractRule; unchecked Reads and Creates remain explicitly separate from call conformance. observation_gaps_and_effect_coverage_are_explicit directly checks both unchecked effects in an otherwise successful call report and rejects an injected unmapped gap. self_permission_rejects_different_and_unknown_receivers checks mismatch failure versus unavailable-identity gaps. unknown_boundaries_roots_and_unbalanced_exits_cannot_pass asserts unknown/root/exit violations and configured-root/unclosed gaps. These assertions would detect false acceptance or disappearance of the named diagnostics.
real_salsa_contract_fixture asserts cold and prewarmed failure, three checked requests, no spurious gaps, exact violation kinds, rule operation and complete root/helper/leaf path, and actual cache reuse without leaf execution. Captured fixture source additionally exercises unmapped generated/missing mappings, absent compiled snapshots with all operation mappings absent, cross-thread cached execution gaps, and malformed lifecycle replays against a conforming baseline. Captured SalsaObserver source records missing provenance, unsupported thread propagation and lifecycle inconsistencies as gaps; unsuccessful mapping remains None instead of borrowing caller identity. Captured query/model/expected fixture data and runtime setup helpers establish the scenarios underlying these assertions.
Deferral: the ordinary call-only evidence does not establish strict whole-scope conformance for input reads, context construction, uninstrumented ordinary helpers or async tasks. Both the explicit TODO implementation and test declared_effects_and_async_boundaries_have_complete_scope_accounting account for this remaining requirement: effect hooks, task-context propagation and instrumentation that detects absent declared-scope observation must exist before complete scope and scenario-context diagnostics can be tested. The stub has no behavioral assertions and is not counted as implementation or execution evidence. Existing path/rule and cold/warm scenario diagnostics cover the implemented subset; full declared-scope/scenario accounting remains visibly TODO. No N/A entries occur. No edits needed for this accurately deferred state.
Execution: ran review start/read and baseline comparisons, then review record; no behavioral tests or workspace build run by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported 321 passing functional tests and successful root build are separate reported evidence.
